pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Cloudy Temple.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Axe and recovery
pages.text: Cumulonimbus has a brief protected interval after a hit and a per-hit damage cap. When the golem permits breaking, a fully charged axe hit damages its shell. The laser and recovery provide different windows: leave the beam line first, then use an available attack.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Air Rune, Atmospheric Boots. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.text: In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Magical Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
